name: E. D. Morse
mentions: …g the arrivals from Deadwood on the Medora stage Tuesday were Mr. and Mrs. N. C. Ludgen, H. M. Janlund, E. D. Morse, M. Franke, O. Kinley, W. Tolbert.
Tuesday's stage from Deadwood made the trip in 36 hours and 5 minutes. If you want to go to the Hills in a hurry, take the M. S. & F. Co.'s route.
